vb_textbox.text: I didn't really find out any hard or fast rule as to how to succeed at this task. I tried different approaches - e.g. alternating between the characters in terms of the shapes and colours of their hats. The other approach I tried was to time my response in terms of whether I selected one of the two characters quickly or whether I waited until the one and a half seconds were almost up. My scores seemed to be a bit higher with this approach (e.g. when I selected the character slowly) but then they would drop again. So I would advise trial and error to see whether you can work out a rule for getting a high score. The most important advice is to make your selection within the time limit, otherwise you'll get no points!
